items.title: EU seeks 'highest level' ties with Canada in Montreal summit
items.description: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said EU seeks "association without accession" for Canada, after EU members snub "associate member" designation.

items.title: Can EU and India work together to secure Indo-Pacific?
items.description: India and Europe are deepening defense ties, but their clashing perspectives on Russia and differing priorities on China are hampering their joint ambitions on maritime security.

items.title: Germany news: Chancellor Friedrich Merz accuses North Korea of threatening Europe's freedom
items.description: Friedrich Merz, who is visiting Seoul, said North Korea is putting Europe's security at risk by sending soldiers to fight for Russia in Ukraine. DW has more.

items.title: European Central Bank (ECB) head Christine Lagarde to step down in February, before her term ends
items.description: European Central Bank (ECB) President Christine Lagarde is to resign nine months ahead of the end of her 8-year term. European Council President Antonio Costa has said the process to find a successor is underway.
